title: The 10 elements
in a
dinner queue
tag_line: Send this to the friend who always says 'worth it'.

Wood.yang: Already found a better place nearby.
Wood.yin: Stays. Makes friends with the next table.

Fire.yang: Stays. It's on TikTok, it must be good.
Fire.yin: Takes photos of the queue for the story.

Earth.yang: Holds the spot for everyone. No complaints.
Earth.yin: Brought snacks for the queue. Of course.

Metal.yang: Checks the wait time. Leaves at 41 minutes.
Metal.yin: Already read every review. Orders ahead.

Water.yang: Knows the owner. Somehow gets a table.
Water.yin: Goes with the flow. Happy either way.

comment_line: Which one is in your friend group? Comment below.
caption:
Send this to the friend who always says 'it's worth the queue' 🍜

Forty minutes for dinner and every element handles it differently: one finds a better place, one holds the spot for everyone, one knows the owner. Which one are you, and who do you queue with?

Your element comes from the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find yours free at the link in bio.
